items.title: Nvidia in the hot seat, Anthropic to test the IPO market, hotter-than-expected US inflation
items.summary:
Host Kevin Kelly, Kelly Intelligence Founder, CEO, and CCO, and his panel of experts weigh in on the alleged plot to spy on Nvidia's Jensen Huang, why retail investors should wait for Anthropic's IPO instead of chasing private markets, and what the next moves should be for the Federal Reserve after the latest inflation print. 

Today's panel includes Drew Pettit, Roundhill Investments' Chief Investment Strategist; Robert Schein, Blanke Schein Wealth Management's chief investment officer; and Christine Short, TMX Wall Street Horizon's Head of Corporate Event Research.

items.title: McDonald's Expands Uber Partnership: Can It Drive More Growth?
items.summary: MCD expands its Uber partnership across 14 global markets to boost delivery, digital ordering and loyalty, while improving convenience and driving incremental sales growth.

items.title: What Is Uber Technologies (UBER) Gaining From Its Expanded 14 Market Delivery Tie Up?
items.summary: Uber Technologies (NYSE:UBER) and McDonald’s agreed a multi-year expansion of their delivery and loyalty partnership across 14 global markets. Under the new agreement, Uber becomes the preferred integrated delivery provider for McDonald’s app orders in key international countries. The deal links Uber’s and McDonald’s loyalty programs, giving customers new cross-reward earning and redemption options. items.title: Uber Becomes McDonald’s “Preferred Delivery Partner” in 14 Markets as Its DoorDash Fight Widens
items.summary: Key TakeawaysMcDonald’s named Uber the preferred delivery partner for orders placed in its own app, as part of a multi-year expansion across 14 markets for a McDelivery business that brings in more than $20 billion a year. The deal comes days after another big-brand delivery deal, so Uber has now signed two of the biggest consumer brands while DoorDash works through its deal to buy Instacart.

items.title: Lucid Jumps 8% on $1.75 Billion Liquidity Boost Despite Q3 Miss; Rivian Dips, Tesla Little Changed
items.summary: Lucid missed on both revenue and earnings, yet investors rushed in anyway. Behind the rally sits a Saudi backer, a shrinking cash burn, and a risky dependence that Rivian and Tesla avoid.

items.title: Lucid Just Gained 21% in a Week: Take Profits, or Buy More?
items.summary: Key TakeawaysLucid shares are up 21% in the past week with no company news before its third-quarter report. EV stocks bounced after the midterms, while Rivian had upgrades and a gross profit behind its rise.
